metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-45.432798, 140.468626) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use ocean color chlorophyll-a (chlor_a) from NASA OBPG L3SMI: primary NASA/OBPG/MODISA/L3SMI, fallback to MODIST and VIIRS_SNPP. - Two periods: 2018-11-01 to 2019-03-01 vs 2019-11-01 to 2020-03-01. - Location: Circle of 100 km radius around (-45.432798, 140.468626). 2. Masking strategy: - L3SMI is Level-3 mapped with quality masks applied; no extra cloud mask needed. - Compute valid pixel counts from the mean image mask to assess coverage. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If collection size = 0 even after fallbacks (and slight date widening), output C1. - If valid pixel count = 0 for either period, output C2. - If mean is null/NaN/inf or outside plausible bounds (≤0 or >1000), output C3. - Otherwise, compare period means: up if period2 > period1 (A), else (B). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([140.468626, -45.432798]); const geom = center.buffer(100000); // 100 km const scale = 4000; const periods = [ { label: '2018-11 to 2019-02', start: '2018-11-01', end: '2019-03-01' }, { label: '2019-11 to 2020-02', start: '2019-11-01', end: '2020-03-01' } ]; const datasets = [ 'NASA/OBPG/MODISA/L3SMI', 'NASA/OBPG/MODIST/L3SMI', 'NASA/OBPG/VIIRS_SNPP/L3SMI' ]; function getInfo(eeObj) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject)); } async function getPeriodStats(startStr, endStr) { let chosen = null; let size = 0; let col = null; for (const ds of datasets) { col = ee.ImageCollection(ds) .filterDate(startStr, endStr) .filterBounds(geom) .select('chlor_a'); size = await getInfo(col.size()); if (size > 0) { chosen = ds; break; } } if (!chosen) { // small recovery: widen by ±15 days if still empty const start2 = ee.Date(startStr).advance(-15, 'day'); const end2 = ee.Date(endStr).advance(15, 'day'); for (const ds of datasets) { col = ee.ImageCollection(ds) .filterDate(start2, end2) .filterBounds(geom) .select('chlor_a'); size = await getInfo(col.size()); if (size > 0) { chosen = ds; break; } } // If we only found images in widened window, still proceed using the original dates if possible if (!chosen) return { status: 'C1' }; // Rebuild collection with original dates for fairness; if 0, use widened as last resort let colOrig = ee.ImageCollection(chosen).filterDate(startStr, endStr).filterBounds(geom).select('chlor_a'); const sizeOrig = await getInfo(colOrig.size()); if (sizeOrig > 0) { col = colOrig; size = sizeOrig; } } const meanImg = ee.ImageCollection(col).mean(); const totalCount = await getInfo( ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('one') ); const validCount = await getInfo( meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a') ); if (!totalCount || totalCount === 0) { return { status: 'C2', dataset: chosen, nImages: size, totalCount: totalCount || 0, validCount: validCount || 0, meanVal: null }; } if (!validCount || validCount === 0) { return { status: 'C2', dataset: chosen, nImages: size, totalCount, validCount: 0, meanVal: null }; } const meanVal = await getInfo( meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a') ); if (meanVal === null || meanVal === undefined || !Number.isFinite(meanVal) || meanVal <= 0 || meanVal > 1000) { return { status: 'C3', dataset: chosen, nImages: size, totalCount, validCount, meanVal }; } return { status: 'OK', dataset: chosen, nImages: size, totalCount, validCount, meanVal }; } // 2. Compute stats for both periods const s1 = await getPeriodStats(periods[0].start, periods[0].end); const s2 = await getPeriodStats(periods[1].start, periods[1].end); console.log('Geom: center (-45.4328, 140.4686), r=100km'); // 3. Handle data issues (C1/C2/C3) if (s1.status === 'C1' || s2.status === 'C1') { console.log('At least one period has no images after fallbacks.'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (s1.status === 'C2' || s2.status === 'C2') { console.log('At least one period has 0 valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (s1.status === 'C3' || s2.status === 'C3') { console.log('Invalid statistics (null/NaN/out-of-range).'); console.log('C3'); return; } const cov1 = (s1.validCount / s1.totalCount) * 100.0; const cov2 = (s2.validCount / s2.totalCount) * 100.0; console.log(`${periods[0].label}: Dataset=${s1.dataset}, Images=${s1.nImages}, Mean=${s1.meanVal.toFixed(3)} mg/m^3, ValidPix=${s1.validCount}/${s1.totalCount} (${cov1.toFixed(1)}%)`); console.log(`${periods[1].label}: Dataset=${s2.dataset}, Images=${s2.nImages}, Mean=${s2.meanVal.toFixed(3)} mg/m^3, ValidPix=${s2.validCount}/${s2.totalCount} (${cov2.toFixed(1)}%)`); const delta = s2.meanVal - s1.meanVal; console.log(`Delta=${delta.toFixed(3)} mg/m^3`); // 4. Final Answer if (delta > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.error(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
